{{Quote|Master Unskette and I tried to recruit a child on Orto, but the parents threw stones at us. Referred the case to the Council.|Thame Cerulian's notation in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual of Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A '''child''' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto/Legends|Orto]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TJP" /> At some point prior to [[103 BBY]],<ref name="Cerulian">According to ''The Jedi Path'', Thame Cerulian owned a copy of the book between [[115 BBY]] and 103 BBY. Since the book is meant for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and apprentices, it can be assumed that Cerulian became a Jedi Knight around the time he gave up the ownership of his copy; as Cerulian was still Unskette's apprentice when he wrote the comment on the child's recruiting attempt, it must therefore have happened at some point before 103 BBY.</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Unskette]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thame Cerulian]] came across the child while on Orto together. Recognizing the infant's potential for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], they wanted to recruit the child to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[Parent/Legends|parents]], however, were not ready to hand over their offspring, even throwing stones at the pair to drive them away. Cerulian later recorded the event in his copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', commenting that he and his Master had passed the child's case on to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Force-sensitive child was mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="TJP" />
